overview.summary: Host Git in agent worktrees uses the host-recorded gitdir and refuses a tampered gitlink, so a containerized agent cannot choose what host Git executes.

stories.name: Host Git explicit worktree gitdir

verified.summary: after the review fix round: format gate exit=0; dart analyze --fatal-infos: No issues found!; dart test runtime +5896 ~25, workflow +2159 ~11, dev/fitness +122, all passed; earlier round cli +872 ~5; coding.sh --provider claude --fixture dart -> failed: spec-step promotion 'changed after inspection', a pre-existing same-branch promotion defect reproduced on base f4182b8eb (FIS Implementation Observations)

stories.scope: Route every host Git call against an agent worktree through one authority in host_worktree_git.dart that passes --git-dir/--work-tree from the project's worktrees/<id> record and refuses a rewritten, replaced or missing gitlink; cover workflow sweep, candidate preview, workflow Git port, task accept and diff generation with real-Git tamper tests; correct the security docs and add a changelog entry.
